steps:
7. Turn off PO Communication
Procedure
Navigate to Setup and Maintenance.
Search for Manage Administrator Profile Values.
Search for PO_NOTIFICATION_OVERRIDE_E-MAIL.
Set the profile value to a dummy email address.
Click Save.
Search for PO_CONTROL_SUPPLIER_COMMUNICATION.
Set the profile value to Disable.
Click Save.
Search for PO_FROM_EMAIL_ADDRESS.
Set the profile value to Buyer.
Click Save.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.
